tailoring.headline: Frontend Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Specialist | 5+ yrs E-Commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend and frontend engineer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in JavaScript, responsive design, PWA integration and headless commerce APIs. Proven record of building and customizing storefronts, designing data pipelines, and bridging business and IT through techno-functional analysis. Strong Agile, CI/CD and cloud deployment experience.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SFCC Frontend Developer
cover_en.hook: I am drawn to your vision of creating cutting-edge digital commerce experiences on Salesforce Commerce Cloud. With 5+ years of end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in headless APIs, JavaScript storefronts and PWA integration that align perfectly with your needs.

bullets.label: Frontend Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented responsive storefront components on SAP Commerce Cloud, delivering seamless user experiences across devices.

bullets.label: JavaScript Expertise
bullets.text: Built PWA-enabled frontends using JavaScript, integrating headless APIs to power dynamic product catalogs.

bullets.label: Headless API Integration
bullets.text: Developed OCC REST services and integrated PIM/ERP data pipelines, ensuring real-time product data for front-end consumption.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional specs and delivered robust e-commerce solutions in Agile teams.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: I admire your commitment to pushing the boundaries of digital commerce on the SFCC platform. Your focus on innovative, customer-centric experiences resonates with my passion for building high-performance, headless e-commerce solutions. Joining your team would allow me to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise while expanding into Salesforce Commerce Cloud, contributing to your next generation of storefronts.
tailoring.motivation_short: Eager to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud and JavaScript expertise to drive innovative SFCC front-end solutions for your team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior e-commerce developer with 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud. I’m excited about your SFCC Frontend Developer role and would love to discuss how my JavaScript and headless API experience can add value. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SFCC Frontend Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SFCC Frontend Developer position. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions, I am confident I can contribute to your team’s success.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
